period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 September 2024' (the filing also separately shows a discrete '01 July to 30 September 2024' 3-month column: Net Profit after tax BDT 1,920.58mn, EPS 1.73, included here for reference only, not as a structured line item). Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (3rd_quarter_2024.pdf) is a scanned document; pdftotext -layout extracted 0 lines (no usable text layer). Balance Sheet figures were sourced via direct visual inspection of a 400dpi render of source page 7 (fully internally consistent: Total Liabilities 321,290,685,216 + Total Equity 25,269,192,622 = Total Assets 346,559,877,838). Income-statement figures were cross-validated from two independent sources that agree exactly: (a) a 400dpi render of this filing's own P&L page (source page 9, dated 28 October 2024), and (b) the FY2025 Q3 filing's (FS_Q3_2025.pdf) comparative 'Jan-Sep 2024' column -- both show identical figures (Net Profit after tax BDT 2,660,621,629, EPS 2.40, Provision for tax BDT 2,536,181,186), confirming this period was NOT subject to the deferred-tax restatement found in the FY2025 Q1/H1 filings when compared against their own later (2026) comparative columns. Cross-check: this filing's own comparative 'as at 31 December 2023' column (Total Assets BDT 318,954.68mn, Total Equity BDT 24,097.61mn) diverges from the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2023_Q4.json (Total Assets BDT 319,416mn, Total Equity BDT 25,230mn, sourced from the FY2025 Annual Report's five-year summary table) by approximately 0.14% and 4.5% respectively, while gross loans and total deposits match closely -- the same equity-concentrated interim-vs-annual-report divergence pattern documented in the 2025_Q1/Q2/Q3 files, now also confirmed for the FY2023 year-end comparative. The existing 2023_Q4.json file was NOT modified.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF pages 7 (Balance Sheet, Un-audited) and 9 (Profit and Loss Account, Un-audited), 'Un-audited Financial Statements for the period ended September 30, 2024'. pdftotext -layout extracted 0 lines (no usable text layer, scanned/Canon-scanner PDF); figures sourced via direct visual inspection of 400dpi page renders and cross-validated against FS_Q3_2025.pdf's comparative column.
